_what: The printed heading each mapped group's rows must sit beneath on Form 433-A(OIC). Read by adapters/pdf/verify-headings.mjs. Every `text` below is drawn on the page verbatim; the tool refuses to run if a string cannot be found on its declared page, which makes this file a second, independent pin on the revision.
_why: This form's internal names are semantic rather than positional, which removes 433-A's off-by-one trap and installs a worse one: a name that describes the wrong thing reads as correct. Five such names are already measured (see 433aoi.map.json `_notes`). Nothing in a name can be trusted to say which printed section a row is in, so geometry says it.
_band_rule: Each heading owns the vertical band from its own printed baseline down to the next declared heading on the same page. A widget belongs to the band containing its rectangle. Headings are declared densely enough to bound every group - INCLUDING headings no group claims, because an undeclared heading between two declared ones silently widens the band above it. On page 1 that means declaring the spouse sub-heading and both section rules, not only the one banner household_members sits under.

_page_2_row_labels_are_NOT_declared_as_h: Three phrases on page 2 print at the same left margin as the two sub-banners and could each look like a heading: 'Investment account' (y 524.1 and again at y 452.1), 'Retirement account' (y 272.1) and 'Description of digital asset' (y 365.3). None is declared, for two measured reasons. First, 'Investment account' is drawn TWICE - once per printed row - so it cannot be a unique anchor, and verify-headings.mjs locates a heading by finding its text verbatim on the page. Second, the (2a) row's write-in widget sits at y 525.6, one and a half points ABOVE the 'Investment account' text at y 524.1, so a band opened at that text would exclude a widget of the very group it was meant to bound. They are row labels on the option row, not banners. THE COST OF THIS IS STATED RATHER THAN HIDDEN: with only CASH_AND_INVESTMENTS declared, the heading check cannot tell a bank row bound into an investment slot from a correct one - all three groups are in the same band. What catches that is row_class, which 1ab_bank_accounts, 2ab_investment_accounts and 3a_retirement_accounts each declare, and which refuses a row whose stated asset_class the group does not print. The two mechanisms are complementary here, and on this page the second is the one doing the work.

household_members.heading: HOUSEHOLD_MEMBERS
household_members._why: The four dependent rows print at y 324.0, 309.6, 295.2 and 280.8, between the HOUSEHOLD_MEMBERS sentence at y 358.1 and the Section 2 rule at y 264.5. The spouse block above (y 375.8) is under SPOUSE_INFORMATION and is bound as four scalars, not as rows of this group - which is the distinction this file exists to hold: a spouse is not a row of the household table on this form, and slot order must never be able to put one there.

1ab_bank_accounts.heading: CASH_AND_INVESTMENTS
1ab_bank_accounts._why: Both rows print between the 'Cash and Investments' banner at y 656.2 and the life insurance banner at y 156.9: slot 0 spans y 638.1 down to 612.0 and slot 1 spans 594.9 down to 568.8. Slot 0 is the higher, which is printed order, and printed order here is not interchangeable - slot 0 totals to (1a) and slot 1 to (1b), and only slot 0 prints a Cash option.

6ac_vehicles.heading: VEHICLES
6ac_vehicles._why: Slot 0 spans y 347.0 down to 280.8 and slot 1 spans 228.2 down to 162.0, both inside the 383.1..foot band. THE TWO SLOTS ARE NOT ADJACENT: the (6b) allowance cell at y 266.4 sits between them and is bound as a scalar. That is the one thing on this page a band check cannot see — both slots and the cell between them are in one band — and what keeps a vehicle out of a property slot is row_class, not the band.

7a_other_valuable_items.heading: OTHER_VALUABLE_ITEMS
7a_other_valuable_items._why: The single slot spans y 716.4 down to 673.2, inside the 740.1..671.7 band. THE GROUP HAS ONE SLOT AND NOT TWO, AND THIS FILE IS PART OF WHY: OtherAsset2[0] spans y 648.0..604.8, which is in the NEXT band down, under 'Value of remaining furniture and personal effects'. A two-slot group would put one row under each of two printed headings, and verify-headings.mjs would refuse it. That refusal is not the reason for the decision - the printed headings are - but it is the reason the decision cannot be quietly undone later.

_page_3_row_labels_are_NOT_declared_as_h: Four phrases on page 3 print at or near the same left margin as the two declared sub-headings and could each look like a banner: 'Property description' (y 683.5 and again at y 550.3), 'Current market value' (y 578.6, 445.4, 300.9 and 182.1), 'Vehicle make & model' (y 359.5 and again at 240.7) and 'Location' (y 625.9 and 492.7). NONE is declared, and the reason is the one already recorded for page 2: every one of them is drawn MORE THAN ONCE — once per printed row — so none can be a unique anchor, and verify-headings.mjs locates a heading by finding its text verbatim on the page. They are column headers on a repeating row, not banners. THE COST IS STATED RATHER THAN HIDDEN: within REAL_PROPERTY the band cannot tell slot 0 from slot 1, and within VEHICLES it cannot tell a vehicle row from the (6b) cell that sits between the two rows. What catches a misfiled row is row_class, which both new groups declare, plus the printed-marker evidence recorded per slot in the map.
